components.css: .ds-studio { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:8vw; padding:6vw; background:#11110f; color:#f2f1eb; } .ds-studio-image { position:relative; min-height:520px; border:1px solid rgba(242,241,235,.12); background:#20211e; } .ds-studio-image span { position:absolute; right:16px; bottom:16px; padding:7px 9px; background:#d9f45f; color:#11110f; font-family:Marcellus,serif; } .ds-studio article { align-self:center; } .ds-studio h2 { font:400 clamp(48px,6vw,88px)/.95 Marcellus,serif; } .ds-studio p { max-width:34ch; color:#b0aea5; font:400 17px/1.9 'Zen Old Mincho',serif; }

narrative.overview: NeoRealm LAB treats the selected site as an authored cinematic field. Graphite surfaces, Projection White type, one Acid Signal, sticky storytelling, long media streams, and clipped pointer trails prove current web, AI visual, and motion capability before a supporting legacy archive appears.
keyCharacteristics: Direction B is selected; Direction A remains comparison apparatus only.
Marcellus carries English display, navigation, and labels; Zen Old Mincho carries Chinese and body reading.
The supplied SVG wordmark anchors the navigation.
The 178dvh KV uses the supplied video and a clean loading poster.
Studio synchronizes three generated abstract images with three scrolling chapters.
Two long work streams and the supporting web archive receive bounded desktop depth and clipped pointer trails.
Mobile and reduced-motion modes remove nonessential transforms and video playback.
The live interface demonstrates current web skill without exposing internal strategy; legacy work is supporting provenance.

rules.name: The One-Signal Rule
rules.body: Projection White and graphite neutrals carry most screens so Acid Signal remains rare enough to direct attention.

rules.name: The Marcellus Frame Rule
rules.body: Use Marcellus for English, display, navigation, labels, and release naming.

rules.name: The Zen Reading Rule
rules.body: Use Zen Old Mincho for Chinese and body reading.

rules.name: The Two-Message KV Rule
rules.body: The primary copy exits before the reveal copy enters during ordinary motion.

rules.name: The Sticky Counterpoint Rule
rules.body: Studio holds one visual field while three text chapters advance.

rules.name: The Bounded Trail Rule
rules.body: Fine-pointer media response uses clipped displacement bands and never becomes free dragging or reordering.

rules.name: The Motion-Off Rule
rules.body: Reduced motion pauses video and removes parallax, card drift, and ghost layers.

rules.name: The Sharp System Rule
rules.body: Production geometry stays rectangular; prototype pills do not enter the product identity.

dos: Do use Marcellus for English, display, navigation, labels, and release titles.
Do use Zen Old Mincho for Chinese and body reading.
Do preserve the supplied SVG wordmark and white-on-black navigation treatment.
Do preserve the two-message 178dvh KV and its user-provided video/poster relationship.
Do keep Studio as a 50/50 sticky-image narrative with three scrolling steps.
Do let the current interface prove web capability without narrating internal strategy.
Do keep waterfall interaction bounded to fine-pointer desktop.
Do fully remove video playback and transforms for reduced motion.
donts: Don't use DIN Condensed, Avenir Next, or a generic sans-serif as the selected identity.
Don't expose the QR intro from the supplied video as the KV first frame.
Don't make both KV messages compete during ordinary motion.
Don't turn Studio into a carousel or uniform card grid.
Don't allow release cards to reorder or move without bounds.
Don't enable pointer effects on mobile.
Don't let legacy cases outrank the current experience.
Don't add glow, glossy glass cards, dashboard styling, or cursor tricks outside the media trails.
